badge.description: Compact label for category, metadata, or semantic status. Categorical colors and semantic statuses are distinct.
badge.variant: Visual style. Solid uses a restrained tinted background, with the default gray using the muted background token; strong uses a 600-step fill with its matching 50-step foreground in the light theme and a bright fill with dark text in the dark theme; dot shows a colored indicator. Plain has no background, border or horizontal padding.
badge.color: Named categorical color or a custom color recipe with base and onStrong values.
badge.statusDescription: Visual product status using danger, warning, success, info, or neutral semantic tokens. Supports solid, dot, strong, and plain; strong uses dedicated fill/foreground pairs. No live region is created. Status borders use their semantic border color at 28% opacity.
badge.roleDescription: Optional native ARIA role. Add status only when a dynamically inserted or updated badge should be announced.
badge.accessibilityDescription: The status prop controls appearance only. Badge does not create a live region by default. Add role="status" for a polite dynamic update; static status badges should remain unannounced.
badge.plainDescription: An unboxed dot or icon with a short label. Omit children for an icon-only marker and supply an accessible name, or aria-hidden for a decorative marker. Use InlineNotice for activity and long messages.
badge.leadingIcon: Optional decorative icon; replaces the dot in dot and plain variants. Use an accessible label when children are omitted.
